symptom: Follow-on to #1059: a widget's image and glyph icons were readable but unwritable, so describe -> exec could only be made honest (a `-- NOT re-executable` note), not lossless. Authoring them needed the kind to reach the element $Type through grammar, AST, visitor, builder and BOTH engines.
cause: Three separate vocabularies for the same three Mendix icon elements: types.MenuIconKind (navigation), pages.IconType (the page model's own three-value enum), and a bare string in the widget property map. The page path had no kind at all, so it could not express one.
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (widgetIconV3), mdl/ast/ast_page_v3.go (WidgetIcon), mdl/visitor/visitor_page_v3.go (buildWidgetIconV3), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (buildWidgetIcon), mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (iconToGen), sdk/mpr/writer_widgets_display.go (buildWidgetIconBson), mdl/executor/validate_icon_refs.go, mdl/executor/validate_glyph_codes.go
insight: **Delete the second vocabulary as part of the fix, not after it.** pages.IconType existed for exactly the same three kinds as types.MenuIconKind and had drifted to a different value set; replacing it (2 call sites) is what made the writers a dispatch rather than an inference. A feature that adds a third copy would have re-created the bug in a new place. **The pre-existing tests of the OLD feature are the safety net for the new one**: MDL078's menu tests caught a python replace of mine that silently no-opped (anchor did not match, no assert), which nothing else would have. Always assert on the replacement count when editing by script. **Measure the premise, don't reason by analogy** — extending MDL078 to widget glyphs assumed mxbuild resolves a widget glyph the same way it resolves a menu one. It does, measured: `Icon: glyph 57562` fails `mxbuild --target=deploy` with `System.InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains no matching element` — but it names the **page**, not a layout, so the rule's own message was wrong and had to be corrected from the measurement. **The reference check had the mirror-image bug waiting**: resolving an image reference against the ICON collections reports a correct name as a typo, which is the same conflation pointed the other way — per-kind resolution plus an `otherKindHint` naming the remedy. **An empty listing is 'could not establish', not 'none'** — each half of the index is independent, so a project that yields icon collections but no image collections still resolves what it can. Verified on 11.13.0: all three authored, mx check 0 errors, deploy BUILD SUCCEEDED, right $Type on disk; controls reproduce CE1613 (image written without `image`) and the glyph build failure. Corpus sweep 531 clean.
